symptom: CATALOG.AGENTS, AI_MODELS, KNOWLEDGE_BASES and CONSUMED_MCP_SERVICES held only Id, Name, QualifiedName, ModuleName, Folder and Description, and published MCP services were not catalogued at all: which agents run a tool without approval, which use a model, or have streaming on took one describe agent per agent; a published MCP service's tool and authentication microflows sat in GRAPH_DEAD_ASSETS.
cause: The agent pass inserted the CustomBlobDocument wrapper's fields only; the settings live in the JSON Contents, and DecodeAgentEditorUnit had no case for agenteditor.publishedMCPService (its decoder lived only in the backend, on the sdk/agenteditor types).
insight: Test against the real 11.16 Agent Editor fixtures in mdl/backend/modelsdk/testdata/agenteditor, not hand-written JSON: one stores the streaming switches and one does not, which is the NULL-vs-0 control for free. A boolean the document may not store must be a nullable column, or 'streaming off' and 'older Agent Editor' read the same. A published service's microflows are `publish` edges, matching published REST/OData, not `call`. Cross-check an empty column with describe before suspecting the decoder: an AI model with no type or display name and an agent with no model are real in the starter app. Measured on the Agent Builder starter app: GRAPH_DEAD_ASSETS 212 -> 210 (mcptool1, auth_mf), none newly dead.
